body.title: Error installing CLI on Linux
body.body:
Hey Peter, thanks for building Pushin!

I tried to use the install script on my Fedora Linux on `bash`, and got the following error:

```sh
$ PUN_VERSION=0.2.7

case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64)        PUN_PLATFORM=linux-x86_64 ;;
  aarch64|arm64) PUN_PLATFORM=linux-arm64 ;;
  *) echo "unsupported CPU architecture: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

PUN_TMP_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
PUN_ARCHIVE="pushin-cli-v${PUN_VERSION}/dist/${PUN_PLATFORM}/pun"

curl -fsSL \
  "https://pushin.eu/pjullrich/pushin-cli/archive/v${PUN_VERSION}.tar.gz" \
  -o "$PUN_TMP_DIR/pushin-cli.tar.gz"
tar -xzf "$PUN_TMP_DIR/pushin-cli.tar.gz" \
  -C "$PUN_TMP_DIR" --strip-components=3 "$PUN_ARCHIVE"
sudo install -m 0755 "$PUN_TMP_DIR/pun" /usr/local/bin/pun
rm -r "$PUN_TMP_DIR"

pun --version
curl: (22) The requested URL returned error: 404
tar (child): /tmp/tmp.l0M7Dn5HBF/pushin-cli.tar.gz: Cannot open: No such file or directory
tar (child): Error is not recoverable: exiting now
tar: Child returned status 2
tar: Error is not recoverable: exiting now
install: cannot stat '/tmp/tmp.l0M7Dn5HBF/pun': No such file or directory
bash: pun: command not found...
```

The root cause seems to be the invalid `PUN_VERSION=0.2.7` version.

Looking at https://pushin.eu/pjullrich/pushin-cli-tap/blob/main/Formula/pun.rb I can see the version distributed there is `0.2.6`.

But changing the `PUN_VERSION` to `0.2.6` still has an issue:

```sh
$ PUN_VERSION=0.2.6
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64)        PUN_PLATFORM=linux-x86_64 ;;
  aarch64|arm64) PUN_PLATFORM=linux-arm64 ;;
  *) echo "Unsupported CPU architecture: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

PUN_TMP_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
curl -fsSL "https://pushin.eu/pjullrich/pushin-cli/archive/v${PUN_VERSION}.tar.gz" -o "$PUN_TMP_DIR/pun.tar.gz"
tar -xzf "$PUN_TMP_DIR/pun.tar.gz" -C "$PUN_TMP_DIR" --strip-components=3 "pushin-cli-v${PUN_VERSION}/dist/${PUN_PLATFORM}/pun"
sudo install -m 0755 "$PUN_TMP_DIR/pun" /usr/local/bin/pun
rm -r "$PUN_TMP_DIR"
pun --version
tar: pushin-cli-v0.2.6/dist/linux-x86_64/pun: Not found in archive
tar: Exiting with failure status due to previous errors
Place your finger on the fingerprint reader
install: cannot stat '/tmp/tmp.iulCLKfGhl/pun': No such file or directory
bash: pun: command not found...
```

Looking at the Tar file I don't see the required `pushin-cli-v0.2.6/dist/linux-x86_64/pun` path the script expects (only MacOS binaries there):

```sh
$ tar zxvf pun.tar.gz
```

So it seems that there's two problems: the `pun` CLI `v0.2.7` isn't available via the `archives` URL, and it isn't being distributed to MacOS users via Homebrew :)
